evidence.snippet: The Polarity Bit of the TMP105 allows the user to adjust the polarity of the ALERT pin output. If POL = 0, the ALERT pin will be active LOW... For POL = 1, the ALERT pin will be active HIGH.
The Thermostat Mode bit of the TMP105 indicates to the device whether to operate in Comparator Mode (TM = 0) or Interrupt Mode (TM = 1).
Shutdown Mode is enabled when the SD bit is 1; the device will shut down once the current conversion is completed. When SD is equal to 0, the device will maintain a continuous conversion state.
